name_en: Differently Abled Pension Scheme (with Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme)
department: Revenue Administration and Disaster Management Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You get Rs 1,500 every month (raised from Rs 1,000 on 1 January 2023). If you are very poor and have 80% disability or more, part of this comes from the central IGNDPS scheme. You also get a free saree or dhoti at Pongal and Deepavali, and free rice.

other: You must have 40% disability or more.
You must have no job. If you work in a private job or for yourself, your income must not be more than Rs 3 lakh a year.
For the central IGNDPS part: 80% disability or more, and your family must be below the poverty line.

how_to_apply: Apply online on the TN e-Sevai website (tnesevai.tn.gov.in). Revenue officers check your form. If you are eligible, the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) orders your pension. Forms are settled within 30 days.
